title: DeepSeek opens app-level API with tool orchestration and multimodal endpoints
summary: DeepSeek announced an expansion of its API that exposes app-level conversational capabilities: developers enable the corresponding parameters in the existing API to get deep-thinking search, file input, link reading and voice, with tool invocation and context assembly handled server-side. The company said the V4.1-Flash model is supported across three interfaces, and that Search, Fetch, OCR, ASR and TTS can also be called individually. It also open-sourced a frontend chat demo \(deepseek-ai/chat-demo, with a hosted instance at deepseek-ai.github.io/chat-demo\) that can import existing conversation history, so developers can run a DeepSeek web-style client locally against the API. The post did not disclose pricing, rate limits, regional availability, or independent performance results.
